data.Name: The Invisible Hand
data.Subtitle: Imposing Flagship
data.FrontText:
When Played: Create 4 Battle Droid tokens. 
On Attack: Exhaust any number of friendly Separatist units. Deal 1 damage to the defending player's base for each unit exhausted this way.

data.Name: Tranquility
data.Subtitle: Inspiring Flagship
data.FrontText:
When Played: You may return a Republic unit from your discard pile to your hand. 
On Attack: Each of the next 3 Republic cards you play this phase costs 1 less.
